pages.text: $(l)Petal Storm$() unleashes a storm of razor-sharp petals that slice through all enemies in an area.$(br2)$(l)Max Level:$() 5$(br)$(l)Type:$() AoE Attack$(br)$(l)Botania Mana Cost:$() 25,000 + 12,000/level$(br2)Hits multiple targets in a radius around you with knockback. The petal projectiles can be enhanced by Bore Lens (pierce) and Velocity Lens (speed + range) catalysts.

pages.title: Scribing the Scroll
pages.text: Scrolls are not crafted at a table. Set a $(l)Scroll Forge$() with $(l)Uncommon Ink$() and a Botany focus — a $(l)Spell Petal$(), a $(l)Botanical Focus$(), or any item tagged $(t)#ironsbotany:focus/botany$() — then choose $(l)Petal Storm$() from the spell list.$(br2)The ink rarity sets the highest spell level the forge will scribe, so richer ink is the only way to reach the upper levels of this spell.
